strengths: Preserves the OpenAI SDK and minimizes client rewrite
GPT-5.x on Bedrock Mantle is served through the Responses API
constraints: Mantle itself has no cross-region form for any GPT model (in-region only); for GPT-5.6, GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 the bedrock-runtime CRIS path covers additional regions instead (see runtime_converse)

Chat Completions support on Mantle is model-specific: every GPT-5.6 (Sol, Terra, Luna), GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4 and GPT-6 model card lists Chat Completions as supported on bedrock-mantle (cards read 2026-11-08). A Chat Completions source reshapes to Responses only when the selected model's card leaves Chat Completions unchecked — verify in the target account
Availability must be probed in the target account and region

strengths: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions surface for models that accept it
constraints: Model-specific: listed as supported on bedrock-mantle by the GPT-5.6 Sol, Terra and Luna cards (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-56-sol.html, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-56-terra.html, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-56-luna.html), the GPT-5.4 and GPT-5.5 cards (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-54.html, https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-card-openai-gpt-55.html) and the GPT-6 cards (all read 2026-11-08); reshape to Responses only when a model's card leaves Chat Completions unchecked. Uses /openai/v1/chat/completions
Availability and model support must be probed in the target account and region

strengths: Supports Bedrock Guardrails (Converse API only) and model invocation logging — both bedrock-runtime-only; CloudWatch metrics exist on both endpoints (AWS/Bedrock on runtime, AWS/BedrockMantle on Mantle; https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/monitoring-mantle-metrics.html, read 2026-11-07)

This is a SAME-MODEL governance path via CRIS. GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna publish us./in./us-gov./global. ids; us./global. only for GPT-5.6 Sol, GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.4 (their model cards list no in. or us-gov. profile; cards read 2026-11-08). The base URL for the OpenAI-compatible APIs is bedrock-runtime.{region}.amazonaws.com/openai/v1. The model cards recommend runtime for new applications, and for GPT-5.6 Global CRIS is priced at OpenAI's standard rate (cost parity)
constraints: GPT-5.5 / GPT-5.4 on runtime are CRIS-only (us. and global. ids; no in-region form) per their model cards (read 2026-11-06); the cards publish In-Region (1.10x) pricing only, so do not assume Global CRIS price parity for them

GPT-5.6 on runtime is CRIS-only (no in-region form); Geo CRIS stays within the geography, Global CRIS routes anywhere — pick by data-residency posture. For GPT-5.6, runtime does not support server-side tool use; application inference profiles are Converse-only; the GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna cards (read 2026-11-08) document JSON Schema structured outputs for non-streaming Responses/Chat Completions calls, not yet carried as catalog capabilities; implicit prompt caching applies on Responses/Chat Completions/Invoke/Converse and explicit caching is Responses-only

GPT-5.5 / GPT-5.4 on runtime (per their model cards, read 2026-11-07): server-side tool use is unsupported; structured outputs and implicit prompt caching are Responses-only; Guardrails and application inference profiles are Converse-only
Bedrock-native models generally require a Global or geography-scoped CRIS inference profile
Availability must be probed in the target account and region

strengths: Default endpoint per bedrock-endpoint-policy.md: AWS recommends bedrock-runtime for most new applications (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/endpoints.html, read 2026-11-07)
Keeps the OpenAI SDK and the source Responses API — only base_url and api_key change (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/inference-responses-api.html, read 2026-11-07)

Model invocation logging (including the OpenAI-compatible APIs) and CloudWatch AWS/Bedrock metrics apply (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/model-invocation-logging.html, read 2026-11-07)
SAME-MODEL path whose model ID is the CRIS inference profile: us. or global. ids; in. additionally for GPT-5.6 Terra and Luna only (model cards read 2026-11-07)
constraints: Always synchronous: background=true is rejected with a 400 error; store keeps its default (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/endpoints.html, read 2026-11-07)
Default project only — additional Projects are bedrock-mantle only (https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/userguide/inference-responses-api.html, read 2026-11-07)
No Web Search or other server-side/pre-configured tools on bedrock-runtime; those are bedrock-mantle selectors per bedrock-endpoint-policy.md

Guardrails and application inference profiles are Converse-only on the GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna, GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4 and GPT-6 Astra cards; the GPT-6 Sol, GPT-6 Luna and GPT-6.1 Sol cards list wider Guardrails API scopes while application inference profiles stay InvokeModel/Converse-only — read the selected card (cards read 2026-11-07)
IAM needs bedrock:InvokeModel on the inference profile and on the account's default project (arn:aws:bedrock:{region}:{account-id}:project/default)
Availability must be probed in the target account and region
